title: Safety Checklist
description: Free Safety Checklist template you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers inspection information, section 1: general workplace conditions, section 2: fire safety.
html:
Inspection Information

INSPECTION ID: CHK-__________ DATE: ______________ TIME: ______________

INSPECTOR: ______________ DEPARTMENT: ______________

AREA/LOCATION: ______________ SHIFT: ______________

INSPECTION TYPE: ☐ Daily ☐ Weekly ☐ Monthly ☐ Quarterly ☐ Annual ☐ Special

Section 1: General Workplace Conditions

ITEMINSPECTION ITEMSTATUSCOMMENTS
1.1Housekeeping
- Aisles and walkways clear
- Floors clean and dry
- Trash disposed properly		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
1.2Lighting
- Adequate illumination
- Emergency lighting functional		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
1.3Exits & Egress
- Exits clearly marked
- Exit signs illuminated
- Doors open easily
- No obstructions		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
1.4Ventilation / HVAC
- Adequate air flow
- Temperature comfortable
- No unusual odors		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________

Section 2: Fire Safety

2.1Fire Extinguishers
- Properly mounted
- Accessible (36" clearance)
- Inspected within 30 days
- Seals intact
- Pressure in green zone		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
2.2Fire Alarm System
- Pull stations accessible
- Annunciator panel functional
- Horns/strobes operational		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
2.3Sprinkler System
- Heads unobstructed
- Escutcheon plates present
- No leakage or damage		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
2.4Flammable Materials
- Stored in approved containers
- Properly labeled
- Away from ignition sources
- Quantity within limits		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________

Section 3: Electrical Safety

3.1Electrical Panels
- Clear access (36" clearance)
- Properly labeled
- Covers in place		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
3.2Cords & Wiring
- No frayed or damaged cords
- No overloaded outlets
- No extension cords as permanent wiring
- GFCI in wet areas		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
3.3Equipment Grounding
- All equipment properly grounded
- Ground prongs intact		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
3.4Lockout/Tagout
- Devices available
- Procedures posted
- Tags in good condition		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________

Section 4: Personal Protective Equipment (Ppe)

4.1Head Protection
- Hard hats available
- In good condition
- Worn where required		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
4.2Eye & Face Protection
- Safety glasses available
- Goggles available for chemical work
- Face shields available
- Properly stored		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
4.3Hand Protection
- Gloves available for tasks
- Chemical-resistant gloves available
- No damage or deterioration		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
4.4Foot Protection
- Steel-toe boots worn where required
- Slip-resistant footwear		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
4.5Hearing Protection
- Ear plugs/muffs available
- Posted in noise areas
- Annual audiometric testing		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
4.6Respiratory Protection
- Respirators available
- Fit testing current
- Medical evaluation current
- Cartridges appropriate		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________

Section 5: Machine Guarding & Equipment Safety

5.1Machine Guards
- All guards in place
- No missing or damaged guards
- Interlocks functional		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
5.2Emergency Stops
- Clearly marked
- Easily accessible
- Functional test passed		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
5.3Material Handling Equipment
- Forklifts inspected
- Horns, lights, alarms working
- Load capacity clearly marked		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
5.4Lifting Equipment
- Slings, chains inspected
- Hoists and cranes certified
- Annual inspection current		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________

Section 6: Chemical Safety

6.1Hazard Communication
- SDS available and accessible
- Chemical inventory current
- Containers properly labeled		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
6.2Storage
- Incompatible materials segregated
- Secondary containment in place
- Approved storage cabinets		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
6.3Spill Response
- Spill kits available
- PPE for spill response available
- Employees trained		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________

Section 7: Fall Protection

7.1Working at Heights
- Guardrails in place (4'+)
- Fall protection worn (6'+)
- Anchor points certified		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
7.2Ladders
- In good condition
- Properly rated
- Used on stable surface
- No missing rungs		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
7.3Scaffolding
- Competent person inspection
- Guardrails and toe boards
- Stable base		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________

Section 8: Training & Documentation

8.1Training Records
- New employee orientation completed
- Annual refresher training current
- Specialized training records		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
8.2Safety Meetings
- Monthly meetings held
- Attendance records maintained
- Topics documented		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________
8.3Incident Records
- Incident reports completed
- Investigations documented
- Corrective actions tracked		☐ OK ☐ Needs Improvement________

Summary & Corrective Actions
